messages:
tim: FYI I merged a change to the gpupool module that toggles kms_key_mode from "alias" to "external" for HSM support. GitOps reconcile in eu-west-1 is erroring out.

kaitlyn: ugh saw the alert. paste the error?

tim: ```
Error: error reading KMS Key: KeyNotFoundException: Key not found
  on .terraform/modules/gpupool/main.tf line 84, in data "aws_kms_key" "customer":
  84: data "aws_kms_key" "customer" {

Reconcile failed: flux reconcile --namespace infra eu-west-1/gpupool: plan failed
```

raj: That rings a bell — the new mode expects a pre-provisioned CMK and no longer creates the alias resource. The module default flipped which broke all infra repos that relied on the old behavior. Was that intentional in the PR?

tim: PR #4523 — intention was to add an opt-in "hsm" path but the default got changed accidentally. I pushed the change to upstream gpupool module yesterday. Link: https://git.company/redwood/gpupool/pull/4523

deploy-bot: flux: reconciliation failed for kustomization gpupool (namespace infra) in eu-west-1 at 2024-10-03T09:05:21Z : plan error

sara: Ok immediate mitigation: pin the gpupool module version in the infra repo to previous tag (v1.8.2) and pause flux for eu-west-1 until we have a stable rollout plan. We should NOT run terraform apply manually in prod.

raj: I agree. Also we need a quick compatibility shim in the module: keep creating alias if kms_mode != "external" and add a deprecation warning. Then we can roll module changes behind a feature flag var.

kaitlyn: I'm going to pause flux reconcile for the eu-west kustomization now. Command: `flux suspend kustomization gpupool -n infra --kubeconfig=/secrets/eu-west-kubeconfig`

tim: I'll open a revert PR in infra repo to pin module version and add a temporary override variable. Patch gist: ```hcl
module "gpupool" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/gpupool"
  version = "v1.8.2"
  kms_mode = var.kms_mode # keep current behavior
}
```

sara: Also add an entry in the rollout playbook: run `terraform plan` in staging for the pinned version, validate KMS creation, then only unpause flux once module change + tests are ready.

raj: Long term: add an acceptance test to the module CI that runs a minimal tf apply across all supported kms_mode values (managed, alias, external) in a disposable aws account. Catch default flips.

tim: I'll revert the upstream PR in gpupool as well and open a new PR that introduces `kms_mode` enum + backward-compatible alias creation. ETA ~1h.

kaitlyn: Confirmed flux paused for eu-west-1. I'll watch the reconcile logs and unpause once you confirm revert is merged.

deploy-bot: PR 4526 created: infra: pin gpupool -> v1.8.2 (tim). CI: staging plan OK.

tim: Merged revert PR to upstream gpupool and created compatibility shim. Need someone to review the acceptance test addition.

raj: Reviewing now. After merge we should bump module in infra and do a staged rollout: staging -> canary eu-west -> all regions. Also add a changelog entry and notify platform consumers.

sara: Good. Postmortem note: accidental default changes are high-risk. Add checklist item in module release process: explicit semver-major for default behavior changes and a mandatory opt-in feature flag in minor releases.

tim: Agreed. I'll file the release-process PR. Thanks all :thumbsup:

flux-bot: kustomization gpupool namespace infra suspended by kaitlyn at 2024-10-03T09:12:03Z

kaitlyn: I'll unpause after raj gives the go-ahead on the merged shim.

raj: Go-ahead given, unpause after infra bump lands and flux sees the pinned version stable for 30m.

kaitlyn: Roger.
